rationale: Price is at 98.7% of today's range, essentially at the session high ($421.39), with the last candle showing a micro-pullback from that high — entering long here means buying at resistance with minimal room before the day's high acts as a ceiling, while a short against a strong intraday uptrend (price well above VWAP at $414.75 and above 9-EMA at $419.39) carries momentum risk. With only 57 minutes to close and the stock already up ~$14 from the session low, the risk/reward in either direction is unfavorable: longs face immediate resistance and shorts face a strong uptrend. The spread and ATR are manageable, but the positional setup offers no clean entry with asymmetric reward.
